question: In which of the following years was the first edition of the Indian Super League (ISL) held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Indian Super League (ISL) is a professional football league in India.

• The league was officially launched on October 12, 2014.

• The aim of the ISL is to promote football in India and to develop a strong football culture in the country.

• The league operates on a franchise model, similar to the Indian Premier League (IPL) in cricket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Indian Super League (ISL)**

• The ISL is one of the top football leagues in India, alongside the I-League.

• The league was founded in 2013 and the first season kicked off in 2014.

• The league was established to enhance the profile of Indian football and to attract more fans to the sport.

• It features a mix of Indian and international players, and its matches are broadcasted on television and online streaming platforms.

• Each season culminates in a playoff series, with the top teams competing for the championship title.

• **Franchise Model**

• The ISL operates on a franchise-based model, where each team is owned by a private entity or a group of investors.

• This model is similar to other sports leagues like the Indian Premier League (IPL) in cricket.

• The franchise owners are responsible for the financial and operational management of their teams.

• This model aims to provide financial stability and attract investment in the sport.

• **Development of Football in India**

• The ISL aims to develop grassroots football in India through various initiatives and programs.

• The league has partnered with several football academies and development programs to nurture young talent.

• ISL teams often conduct football clinics, training sessions, and talent scouting programs to identify and support young players.

• The league also works with the All India Football Federation (AIFF) to promote football at the national level.
